# Flowtime

Flowtime is a flexible focus timer and personal time tracker with Pomodoro, reminders, projects, and optional app blocking on iPhone and Android.

Official website:
https://flowtime-app.com/

Full documentation:
https://flowtime-app.com/llms-full.txt

About Flowtime:
https://flowtime-app.com/about-flowtime/

Press Kit:
https://flowtime-app.com/press/

Guides:
https://flowtime-app.com/guides/

App Store:
https://apps.apple.com/ch/app/flowtime-adhs-fokus-timer/id6768056969

Google Play:
https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.avocadowitharms.flowtime

Privacy policy:
https://gugus.software/privacy/flowtime/

Support:
https://flowtime-app.com/docs/support.html

Core features:
- Flexible focus sessions
- Standard timer
- Pomodoro
- Focus reminders
- Optional app blocking
- Personal time tracking
- Projects
- Session history
- Reports

Best-fit use cases:
- Flexible focus sessions
- Time-awareness check-ins
- Flexible Pomodoro alternatives
- Focus sessions for work and study
- Reducing distracting app checks
- Personal project time tracking without an account

Flowtime is designed to reduce friction, keep focused time visible, and make intentional stopping easier.
